limitations: Proved only for C-infinity strictly convex planar bodies with positive curvature. The controlled metric is the H^{-1} deviation of the curvature radius, not Fraenkel asymmetry or Hausdorff distance. Constants are explicit but not optimized. No extension to arbitrary finite-perimeter sets or nonsmooth convex bodies is claimed. Very recent concurrent work or a non-obvious endpoint consequence of other stability frameworks remains a residual originality risk. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
provenance: Previously published finding; fresh independent assessment pending.
record_title: Global curvature-radius stability for the planar fractional-perimeter maximum
